question.problem:
$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}^{′}(t)=2{x}_{1}(t)+1 \\ {x}_{2}^{′}(t)=-3{x}_{1}(t)-{x}_{2}(t),\end{aligned}\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -2\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the initial value problem above. By applying the Laplace transform $L$ to both sides of each equation in our system, we get a system with variables ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}.$ In terms of the parameter $s,$ the solution of the new system is

${X}_{1}(s)=\frac{1}{s(s-2)}$ ,$\,$
${X}_{2}(s)=$ {{field-1}}.
question.worked_solution:
First, we compute the Laplace transforms of both sides of each equation in our system:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}L\{{x}_{1}^{′}(t)\}=L\{2{x}_{1}(t)+1\} \\ L\{{x}_{2}^{′}(t)\}=L\{-3{x}_{1}(t)-{x}_{2}(t)\}\end{aligned}\,\,
$$

Using the derivative property of the Laplace transform, we obtain the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}sL\{{x}_{1}(t)\}-{x}_{1}(0)=2L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}+L\{1\} \\ sL\{{x}_{2}(t)\}-{x}_{2}(0)=-3L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}-L\{{x}_{2}(t)\}\end{aligned}
$$

which can be simplified to the following:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}s{X}_{1}(s)-0=2{X}_{1}(s)+\frac{1}{s} \\ s{X}_{2}(s)+2=-3{X}_{1}(s)-{X}_{2}(s)\end{aligned}
$$

where ${X}_{1}(s)=L\{{x}_{1}(t)\}$ and ${X}_{2}(s)=L\{{x}_{2}(t)\},$ and we have used the fact that $L\{1\}=\frac{1}{s}.$

Now, solving the first equation for ${X}_{1}(s),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}s{X}_{1}(s) & =2{X}_{1}(s)+\frac{1}{s} \\ (s-2){X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{1}{s} \\ {X}_{1}(s) & =\frac{1}{s(s-2)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting this in the second equation and solving for ${X}_{2}(s),$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}s{X}_{2}(s)+2 & =-3{X}_{1}(s)-{X}_{2}(s) \\ (s+1){X}_{2}(s) & =-3{X}_{1}(s)-2 \\ (s+1){X}_{2}(s) & =-3(\frac{1}{s(s-2)})-2 \\ (s+1){X}_{2}(s) & =(\frac{-3}{s(s-2)})-2 \\ (s+1){X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{-3-2s(s-2)}{s(s-2)} \\ (s+1){X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{-3-2{s}^{2}+4s}{s(s-2)} \\ {X}_{2}(s) & =\frac{-2{s}^{2}+4s-3}{s(s-2)(s+1)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solution of the new system in terms of parameter $s$ is 

$$
{X}_{1}(s)=\frac{1}{s(s-2)},\,{X}_{2}(s)=\frac{-2{s}^{2}+4s-3}{s(s-2)(s+1)}.
$$
